scenes.text: Draw a flat shape with 3 corners. Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is triangle. Great work!
Draw a flat shape with 5 sides. Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is pentagon. Great work!
Draw a flat shape with 6 sides. Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is hexagon. Great work!
What is the flat face of a cube? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is square. Great work!
